Binary Search Trees

Codewars Télécharger le .py Énoncé original sur Codewars

Énoncé en bref

Afficher et comparer des arbres de recherche binaires en tenant compte de la structure et des sous-arbres manquants.

Code Python

class Tree(object):

	def __init__(self, root, left=None, right=None):
		assert root and type(root) == Node
		if left: assert type(left) == Tree and left.root < root
		if right: assert type(right) == Tree and root < right.root

		self.left = left
		self.root = root
		self.right = right
        
	def is_leaf(self):
		return not(self.left or self.right)

	def __str__(self):
		if self.left or self.right:
			l = (str(self.left or '_'))+' '
			r = ' '+(str(self.right or '_'))
		else:
			l = r = ''
		return f"[{l}{self.root}{r}]"
    
	def __eq__(self, other):
		return str(self)==str(other)
    
	def __ne__(self, other):
		return str(self)!=str(other)

class Node(object):
    
    def __init__(self, value, weight=1):
        self.value = value
        self.weight = weight
    
    def __str__(self):
        return str(self.value)   
    
    def __lt__(self, other):
        return self.value < other.value
    
    def __gt__(self, other):
        return self.value > other.value
    
    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.value == other.value 

    def __ne__(self, other):
        return self.value != other.value

Cette soumission contient les classes Tree et Node. L’exemple construit un arbre et affiche sa structure.

Exemple d’exécution

arbre = Tree(Node(2), Tree(Node(1)), Tree(Node(3)))
print(arbre)
print(arbre == Tree(Node(2), Tree(Node(1)), Tree(Node(3))))
